systems.system: PO-RALG linking mechanism with local government authorities
systems.tiers: between PO-RALG and local government authorities; a data sharing mechanism, not described further
planned under TSMP II intervention 1.3.11, for dissemination and data sharing

note: No fact fits a closed value: the plan (December 2021) says sub-national statistics production is mostly un-automated for want of ICT infrastructure with records kept in hardcopy, and lists inadequate ICT equipment and internet accessibility among PO-RALG's remaining gaps beside capacity gaps for data collectors in councils, but does not say whether council offices are connected.
